summary: Body recovery of a Jamestown resident killed in the floods; victim located in an unstable collapsed home
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group (assisted FEMA Urban Search and Rescue)
notes: RMR searched the canyon on Monday 2013-09-16 as part of the federal Type II incident response; USAR conducted the recovery; townspeople were given time to say goodbye before the recovery. Also described in Weather.com flood-rescue roundup: Jamestown neighbor killed by a mudslide that crushed his home on Wednesday night (Sept 11).
